header.intro: Do you have to deal with Base64 format? Then this site is perfect for you! Use our super handy online tool to encode or decode your data.

options.destinationCharacterSet: Destination character set for text files.
options.encodeSeparately: Encode each line separately (useful for when you have multiple entries).
options.splitLines: Split lines into 76 character wide chunks (useful for MIME).

text.guide: Simply enter your data then push the encode button.
text.note: To encode binaries (like images, documents, etc.) use the file upload form a little further down on this page.
text.liveModeDescription: Encodes in real-time as you type or paste (supports only the UTF-8 character set).
text.encodeDescription: Encodes your data into the area below.

file.guide: Select a file to upload and process, then you can download the encoded result.
file.input: Click (or tap) here to select a file
